name: Christine P. O’Hearn
service_line_reviewed: Article III service reviewed: 2021–13 September 2026. Selected decisions: 2.

biography.text: Born in 1969 in Camden, New Jersey. O’Hearn received a B.A. from the University of Delaware (1990) and a J.D. from Temple University Beasley School of Law (1993). She spent nearly three decades in private practice in Westmont, New Jersey, and taught as an adjunct professor at Rutgers Law School–Camden. President Biden nominated her to the district court.
